message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Create Dev Build APKs
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  buildAPKs:
    name: build APKs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: mobile
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Uninstall `@sentry/react-native` dependency
        run: |
          pnpm uninstall @sentry/react-native
          pnpm sync:licenses

      - name: Set applicationIdSuffix to ".dev" for release build
        run: |
          sed -i 's/signingConfig signingConfigs\.release/signingConfig signingConfigs.release\n            applicationIdSuffix ".dev"/' android/app/build.gradle

      - name: Set app name to "Music (Dev)"
        run: |
          sed -i 's|<string name="app_name" translatable="false">Music</string>|<string name="app_name" translatable="false">Music (Dev)</string>|' android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml

      - name: Clean generated builds
        run: rm -rf android/app/build/generated/

      - name: Build APKs with Gradle
        run: cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease

      - name: Upload APKs as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: outputAPKs
          path: mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk",
  "rationale": "The workflow currently has no job timeout, risking unbounded resource consumption if a build hangs. Historical CI runs show successful completions in 29–41 minutes. Adding a 60-minute timeout (with operational headroom) aligns with the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern and experimental evidence showing 26.8% elapsed time savings in a similar workflow. The timeout prevents runaway builds while allowing normal variation.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
